title: Document the containment and completion model
description:
State the work-graph's design commitments in user-facing docs: what an edge means, how containment is derived, why containers complete last, and the item address grammar.

## Background

Two load-bearing properties are currently implicit. First, because a container depends on its contents and blocking follows dependency edges, a container never becomes workable until its whole subtree is terminal — an intended consequence stated nowhere. Second, the addressable-item grammar (project scope `@/<kind>/<self-id>`, issue scope `@/issue/<short-id>/<kind>/<self-id>`, and the `<short-id>/<self-id>` sugar form) is documented only in CLI help text; the reference docs under-specify it.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-1: A concepts page states the containment model: one edge kind, container-depends-on-contents direction, hierarchy derived from the DAG plus type levels (never stored), membership labels advisory, containers become workable last.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-2: The reference docs specify the full item address grammar, including both scopes, the reserved `issue` segment, and the sugar form with its kind-inference and ambiguity behavior, matching the implementation in `domain/item.rs`.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-3: All added text states current behavior only, with no references to earlier models or transitional narration.

## Notes

Follow the Diátaxis split already used in `docs/`: the model goes under concepts, the grammar under reference. Mermaid for any diagrams.
